title: studio.page.published.v1
description: A studio owner or admin published the draft of a builder page as a new immutable version, which is live now (synthwerk#46, #106). CloudEvents subject: the page id. The orgid extension and data.org_id hold the identity org id. actor: user:<sub> of the owner or admin. No page content: no title, no section text. Identity copies it to the audit list of the org.

slug.description: URL slug of the page. Never free text.

version.description: The new version. It is live now. Goes up by one per publish.

previous_version.description: The live version before the change. null: nothing was live.
